tei:div.tei:p: 73) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu shin tu zab pa'i man ngag bzhugs: 74) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud: dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru rje: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu ni: skal ldan bu yi don du bstan: dben zhing dga' ba'i gnas mchog tu: spros bcas rtsa gsum gtor ma dang: phyi nang gsang mchod la sogs bshams: spros med rnal 'byor rang dang bstun: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las: dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i rim pa la: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: ka dag skye med chos kyi sku: rang rig ngo bo bla ma la: tha dad med par skyabs su mchi: 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal mtsho las skyobs: 75) lan gsum dang: de nas sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gnyis snang lam gol sems can rnams: rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i phyir: smon 'jug don dam byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: kun bzang ye shes don rtogs shog: lan gsum gyis rang rgyud sbyangs: de nas yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos gnyug ma'i phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: mi dge nyes ltung ci bsags bshags: rang gzhan dge la yi rang ngo: zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: rgyal kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: 76) 'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir bsngo: tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal ni: trām̐: phyi yi maṇ+ḍal snang srid longs spyod dang: nang gi maṇ+ḍal rang lus phung khams bcas: gsang ba rig stong 'od gsal maṇ+ḍal bkod: sku gsum rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub stsol: traṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: de nas bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka:

log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i dpa' bo che: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i gdon tshogs rnams: 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor skyu 'di longs la: yang dag gsang ba'i gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar phyir dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro 'di ru 'dug gyur na: dpal chen sprul pa'i khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrigs: mtshon cha'i char phabs bgegs tshogs rdul du brlag: de bas ma gnas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hu

lu hu lu ham̐'u phaṭa: oṃ suṃ bha ni= sogs drag sngags brjod: de nas srung 'khor ni: 77) hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral gzhi klong nas: skye 'gag 'gyur med chos nyid dbyings: ye shes lnga ldan gur khang niḥ phyi nang bar med chen por gnas: gnyis snang bgegs kyis glags mi rnyed: bsrung ba'i rdo rje'i gur du gyur: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma tig sna dz+wa la bh+rūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig rtsal snang ma 'gags pa: 'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma'i gar: gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i ngang: snang rtog chos kun brda sgo dbye: bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍa la pra we sha ya hoḥ de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: gzhi dbyings 'gyur med 'od gsal klong: lhun grub ye shes stong gsal che: ye nas lha dang 'du 'bral med: gnyug ma'i klong du phyag bgyi'o: na mo gu ru na ma te hūm̐: de nas dam bzung ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig sku gsum don gyi lha'i: rang zhal so mar mjal ba'i phyir: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: srog gi gter bzung yi dam bca': 'gyur med chen po'i rgyas gdab bo: cit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya a: de nas byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 78) byin chen ngo mtshar gnas kyi mchog: 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi mes chen po: kun bzang yab yum byin chen phobs: byin chen ngo mtshar= ye shes lnga klong zhing khams nas: rigs lnga yab yum byin chen phobs: byin chen ngo mtshar= mi mjed sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: dga' rab shrī seng bī ma la: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad+ma 'byung: ye shes mtsho rgyal bai ro sogs: sprul pa sku yis byin= byin chen ngo mtshar= theg pa dgu yi zhing khams nas: yi dam zhi khro gtso dang 'khor: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs byin chen= byin chen ngo mtshar= gnas yul nyer bzhi'i zhing khams nas: 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: gnas gsum mkha' 'gros byin=

byin chen ngo mtshar= rang bzhin dur khrod zhing khams nas: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs: dam can rgya mtshos byin= byin chen mnga' ba'i rgyal rnams kyi: thugs rje'i klong nas byin chen phebs: snang ba lha ru shar ba dang: yul snang zhing khams rol par 'phos: 'byung ba lnga yi sgra rnams kun: chos nyid rang sgrar 79)byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas: gsang gsum ye shes byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum smin par mdzod: mchog thun dngos grub 'thob pa dang: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa brnyes shing: gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ a we sha ya a: de nas mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐ḥ snang srid gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun: kun bzang mchod pa bla na med: 'dod yon lnga yi nye bar spyod: bsam mi khyab pa'i mchod sprin gyis: bde gshegs zhing kun gang bar gyur: ma hā sarba pū dza hoḥ de nas bshags pa ni: ho: rang rig lha dang gnyis su med: gnyis su 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa kun: chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i ngang: rang byung bde chen lha la bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag zang thal skye med stong pa'i mkha': spros pa'i chos kyi mtshan ma ye nas 'das: ma bcos blo 'das gnyug ma'i rang bzhin du: ye shes snang ba ma 'gags snying rje'i rtsal: 80)thugs rje sgyu ma'i rol pa bsam mi khyab: rgyu yi sa bon e yaṃ khaṃ suṃ raṃ: bh+rūm̐ 'phros ma dag 'byung lnga gnas su dag: ye nas sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin shar: skad cig bh+rūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las: rang byung tshad ldan gzhal yas khang chen po: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad dang ldan: chos 'khor gdugs tog rgyal mtshan ba dan dang ཿ nyi zla'i rgyan dang dril g.yer cod paṇa mdzes: ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor ma lus ldan: lhun grub gzhal yas khang pa mtshan nyid rdzogs:

de dbus thugs srog hrīḥyig yongs gyur las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas tshur 'dus: skad cig rang rig rigs kun khyab bdag mchog: o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa: snang srid zil gnon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ldan: spyan gnyis bar snang 'bru tshugs dbyings su gzigs: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas bhan+dha thod bum lte bar 'dzin: sku la nang gos phod ka 'dung ma gsol: 81) za 'og ber dang chos gos rnam gsum gsol: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid theg gsum yon tan rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs sag lham mnabs: mchan g.yon gsang yum kha ṭ+wām̐ rnam par brten: ye shes 'ja' 'od lnga ldan klong na bzhugs: 'khor du dpal chen grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs cha lugs ngoms: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa bsnams: stag sham smad dkris rus rgyan sgom thag gsol: dbu skra thor cog thod skam rtse bran mdzes: zhabs gnyis rol stabs 'ja' 'od 'khyil klong bzhugs: rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas dang: rje 'bangs nyer lnga rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs: lha rnams mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal: ma bsgom gsal stong chen po'i ngang nyid du: gtso dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba'i lha: gsal la der 'dzin med pa'i ngang du bsgom: gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum las: 'od 'phros sku gsum zhing khams nas: ye shes lha tshogs ma lus pa: rigs kyi spyi dpal rnam pa ru: spyan drangs 82)dam tshig dbyer med bstim: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir:

byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin dag pa chos dbyings zhing khams nas: ka dag spros bral bla ma gshegs su gsol: rtsal snang ma 'gags longs sku'i zhing khams nas: rig stong brjod bral bla ma gshegs su gsol: thugs rje 'gro 'dul sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: phyogs med don gyi bla ma= mnyam nyid brdal khyab chen po'i= rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gshegs= bde stong ye shes mchog gi= ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs= tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa'i dur khrod nas: grub brnyes rig 'dzin rnam brgyad= theg pa dgu yi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas nas: yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs= gnas yul skyong zhing bka' dam gnas pa yi: bstan srung chos skyong 'khor bcas= rnal 'byor sgo gsum byin rlobs 83)nyams rtogs spor: gnyis 'dzin bag chags sgrib gnyis sbyang du gsol: zang thal brjod med rig dbyings mngon gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ pheṃ pheṃ: hring hring dzaḥ de nas bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dam tshig rten dang gnyis med par: 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang nyid du: rig stong brjod bral ye shes lha: dbyer med 'ub chub ngang du bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ldan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: rang rig rang byung 'khrul bral dbyings: gtad med rgya yan lta ba'i ngang: rtsol med rang gsal sgom pa che: shar grol gnyis med ye phyag 'tshal: na mo gu ru na ma te hūm̐: de nas phyi mchod ni: hrīḥ snang srid dag mnyam chen po'i ngang: rang byung mtshan ldan snod nang du: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: snang gsal mar me dri chab dang: snang gsal mar me dri chab dang: zhal zas 84)rol mo snyan dbyangs kyis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 'bul:

bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs: shap+da sarba pū dza hoḥ de nas nang mchod ni: hrīḥ dbang po yul drug dgyes skong rdzas: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: rang bzhin sprul pa'i lha mo yis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri wa ra rū pa shap+da= sogs: spar+she pū dza hoḥ de nas gsang mchod ni: hrīḥ nyon mongs ma spang gnas dag pa'i: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med: bde stong gar sgyur rig ma lnga: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga la gus pa yis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri war mu dra gu h+ya pū dza ho: de nas smag raka gtor mchod ni: hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: nyon mongs gnas dag rak+ta dang: brjid ldan ro mchog bha liṃ ta: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 85)'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri wa ra pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha liṃ ta sarba pū dza khā hiḥ de nas sbyor mchod ni: hrīḥ snang stong dbyer med bde ba che: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug ngang: mnyam par sbyar ba'i mchod pa 'di: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri wa ra ma hā su kha pū dza ho: de nas sgrol mchod ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ srid pa e zhal 'bar ba'i klong: ma rig gnyis snang a mu ka: mtshan bcas mtshan med dbyings su bsgralaḥ rig stong lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra kro dha a mu ka ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: de nas de bzhin nyid mchod ni: hrīḥ rang rig dag pa chos sku'i ngang: sna tshogs rang rtsal ma 'gags pa: gnyis med bde ba chen po ru:

mchod yul mchod bya dmigs med mchod: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra gu h+ya dz+nyā na sarba pū dza te na hūm̐ te te te hūm̐ pā na peṃ pū dza 86)khā hiḥ de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rig 'dus rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos nyid ngang las g.yo med gzugs kyi sku: 'gro ba'i mun sel mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs: mthong ba don ldan gu ru'i sku la bstod: gsung dbyangs mi zad yan lag drug cu'i sgras: don dam skye med chos kyi rang sgra ldan: 'gag med tshangs dbyangs gu ru'i gsung la bstod: smra bsam brjod 'das blo bral dgongs pa che: rig stong 'gyur med dus gsum sa ler gzigs: rdo rje bdun ldan gu ru'i thugs la bstod: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i re skong 'dod pa sgrub: sna tshogs thabs kyis bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin: ma hā gu ru'i yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: las bzhi dbang mdzad phrin las lhun gyis grub: rgyal bstan 'dzin zhing bdud srin gnod pa zlog: lha 'dre dam btags gsang sngags bstan gzhi btsugs: ma hā gu ru'i phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: tshogs yul gnas dag rang byung dur khrod brgyad: zab rgyas dgongs pa'i grub brnyes dpal spyod pa: he ru ka dpal rig 'dzin brgyad 87)la bstod: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba'i lha: zhi dang khro bo'i rol gar sna tshogs ston: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde stong ye shes bskyed cing dngos grub brnyes: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dud khrod gnas yul kun gyi gnyer 'dzin pa: dam can gter bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ bdag rtog gnyis snang 'khrul dbang gis: gsang sngags gzhung bzhin ma byas pa'i: nyams chag nyes ltung ci bsags pa:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: oṃ gu ru badz+ra satwa= sogs/ āḥ de nas 'dzab ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rig 'dus he ru ka'i: thugs srog hūm̐ yig sa bon mthar: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: snang grags lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: ye nas dag pa chen po ru: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer gyis ni: khyer so gsum ldan ngang du bzlas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang: bye ba bzlas pas dngos grub brnyes: don gnyis 'grub par the tshom med: sa ma ya: rang nyid rig 'dus kyi gnas lnga'i 88)rtsa 'khor thams cad du yid dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs thams cad bkra lam mer gsal ba'i thugs srog hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba thams cad ye shes yon tan mthu stobs nus pa thams cad la mnga' brnyes shing snang grags rig gsum thams cad dag mnyam chen por shar bar bsams: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa sgrub sngags khri tsho gsum gyis 'grub: rtags mtshan mi 'gyang nges par gsal: sa ma ya: rang nyid rig 'dus su gsal ba'i thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gi mtha' mar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rtsa gnas kyi dpa' bo yab yum thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng la thim pas zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun grub kyi las rab 'byams ma lus pa 'grub par bsams: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ rtags mthong dus grangs brgya stong khri: bzlas pas mchog thun dngos grub brnyes: sku gsum mngon du gyur nas kyang: pad 'byung rang rig klong du mjal: the tshom med do gu h+ya rgya: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes rim tshogs mchod la: thabs shes māṃ sa dza gad dang:

89) ri sgog klung sgog zas sna tshogs: dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru yi rigs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sogs: bye brag 'dod yon 'os tshad bshams: lha yi ting 'dzin dag pa'i ngang: byin rlabs bya ba 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: thugs las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros: ma dag dri ma stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i rang gdangs ma 'gags pa: rigs lnga yab yum sa bon gyur: mnyam sbyor dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga: zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i rdzas: kun bzang nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo= sogs/ sarba pū dza hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab bya: de nas spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min dag pa chen po'i zhing khams nas: sku gsum ston pa rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: 'du ba tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams nas: o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje rig 'dzin brgyad: 'du ba tshogs= bde stong mchog gi dngos grub mdzod 'dzin ma: khrag 'thung dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'du ba tshogs= theg dgu'i yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang: dam can 90)srung ma'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa: 'du ba tshogs kyi= rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rnal 'byor pho mo'i sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis mthar phyin shog: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi dza gad skyemasaḥ bde stong zag med ye shes bskyed pa'i rdzas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bzhes nas mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid ye dag chos nyid klong:

ye shes lnga yi rgyan du shar: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas grub brnyes dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra ga ṇa tsakra pad+ma pū dza hoḥ de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin lha tshogs ma lus dgongs: bdag cag ma rig las dbang gis: gsang sngags dam tshig nyams pa kun: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra sa twa sa ma ya= āḥ 91)de nas bsgral bstab ni: hrīḥ bdag nyid rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha: dbang chen drag po'i sku bzhengs la: gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dgra bgegs bkug: mtshan bcas mtshan med klong du bsgral: snang ba stong chen khro bo'i lha: kun rtog ru tra zhal du bstabs: dgyes bzhes dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra pad+ma kro dha sa pā ri wā ra a mu ka ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ de nas tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: bza' bca' btung ba thabs shes rdzas: tshim pa drug ldan bla na med: rdo rje mched lcam 'dus pa'i tshogs: bde stong mchog gi dngos grub rol: a la la hoḥ de nas lhag ma ni: pheṃ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan dam can tshogs: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong lhag mgron rnams: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi lhag ma bzhes: rnal 'byor gang bcol 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas bskul pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i rngams klong nas: he ru ka dpal thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: gtum drag 92)'bar ba'i sku ru da bzhengs 'tshal: log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: rang bzhin dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad skur bzhengs 'tshal: theg dgu'i gzhal yas gnas yul nyer bzhi nas: yi dam zhi khro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: chos skyong dam can ma lus skur bzhengs 'tshal: zhing bcu'i ru tra dam nyams rdul du rlog:

mtha' mi du ru ka yi sde tshogs brlag: bla med gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas: bstan 'dzin dam pa'i sku tshe rab brtan nas: don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas chad tho ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dus gsum dus med ka dag dus kyi tshe: rang snang don gyi 'og min chen po'i zhing: sku gsum ston pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong bar dam bcas pa'i: dpal mgon dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs: chos skyong srog bdag gter srung thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan bka' dam ji bzhin du: zab gter dar rgyas bstan 'dzin sku tshe srings: dam nyams bstan dgra brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas bstan skyong ni: bh+yo: rig 'dzin 93) pad+ma thod phreng gi: dam gnas bod skyong bstan ma'i tshogs: dpal gyi pham 'bab mchod gtor bzhes: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' rgyas shing: chos log bstan pa bsnubs pa dang: rnal 'byor bsam don lhun grub mdzod: ma ma hring hring bha liṃ ta khā hiḥ de nas bro mnan ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid rig stong he ru kas: ma rig dam nyams dgra bgegs steng: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bro brdung bas: kun btags mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs kun: mtshan med ri rab chen po'i 'og: sku gsum rdo rje'i phyag rgyas mnan: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: sarba sha truṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: mchod bstod bya zhing lhag chad bskang: de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni: kye hoḥ rig 'dzin lha tshogs ma lus dgongs su gsol: gsang gsum yon tan mi zad dkyil 'khor nas: dngos grub dam pa stsol ba'i dus la babs: bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas: da ni bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' ru phyin: lus snang lha ru smin pa'i dngos grub stsol: ngag la tshangs dbyangs gsung gi dngos grub stsol: sems la 'khrul bral thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: thun mong grub 94) brgyad mchod tu rig 'dzin bzhi:

zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes brjod dngos grub rdzas la rol: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig rmongs pa yis: gsang sngags gzhung bzhin ma byas pa'i: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: bag med nyams chag ci bsags pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brjod: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ bdag gis bla ma bsgrubs pa yiḥ zag bcas zag med dge bsags gang: srid pa'i 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog: de nas smon lam ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i bsod nams dpal yon gyis: bdag cag sgrub pa'i mched lcam kun: 'og min rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing: mi gnas gtan srid zin par shog: de nas gshegs bsdu ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du muṃ: bdag bskyed dam tshig sems dpa' ni: rig dbyings 'gyur 95)med chen por āḥ de nas go bgo lhar ldang pa ni: hrīḥ rgyal kun gsang gsum ye shes gcig 'dus pa: mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum du rgyas gdab bo: skad cig stong gsal chen po'i ngang nyid du: gzugs sku sgyu ma'i tshul gyis don bya'o: sa ma ti āḥ de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ mdzad pa mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don ston pa: sku gsum bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub thams cad ma lus stsol mdzad pa'i: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= bar chad sel zhing bde stong bskyed pa'i ma: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi= phrin las thams cad 'bad med sgrub mdzad pa'i: chos skyong bstan srung rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: dngos grub brnyes shing don gnyis 'grub:

the tshom med do sa ma ya: e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gi: bla sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng: rjes 'jug bu yi don du bstan: ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam mthil: dgongs pa'i dbyings su brda ru sbos: ma 'ongs nyi shu'i dus kyi tshe: las ldan bu dang 'phrad nas kyang: 'gro don shar dang lho nas 'byung: de dus smon log dam sri yis: mi 'dod rkyen ngan bar chad brtsams: 96) gter bdag gnyer bcol 'phrin las bskul: chos bdag mañju shrī dang: sa man+ta sogs phrad nas kyang: bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub par nges: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: gter du zungs la rim bzhin du: chos bdag skal ldan bu la sprod: yal bar ma dor sa ma ya: log lta can la gu h+ya rgya: skal med rnams kyi snying rtsa chod: snod ldan bu yis nyams su longs: dngos grub thob par the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes pa bla sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di yang sprul sku rnam gsum gyi bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag po 'jigs med dkon mchog dpal ldan rgya mtsho rasmi shrī sogs kyis yun ring gi bar rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇ+ḍal bcas bskul ba dang*/ dus la bab tshe chos kyi bdag po skal ldan snyan grags dang pad+ma lhun grub gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ skyon kun ldan pa dud 'gro lta bu'i 'chol mo brdzun rkyal bde ba'i rdo rjes chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong nas mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud las dag par bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ dge'o//
